newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor offers for 35 pct of Spanish CSI.
newsitem.headline: Usinor offers for 35 pct of Spanish CSI.

text.p: French steel group Usinor Sacilor said it was lodging an offer on Friday for 35 percent of Spain's CSI steel group and that this amounted to an investment of 3.35 billion francs.
It said in a statement its offer would also involve a bond subscription to the tune of one billion francs.
"The Spanish cabinet must decide imminently, among declared suitors, who will be the industrial partner involved in the privatisation of CSI," it said.
Usinor added in its statement that Corporacion Siderurgica Integral (CSI) had turnover of 13.4 billion francs in 1996 and production of around 3.8 million tonnes.

It said the offer in Spanish currency was worth 84 billion pesetas in investment and a bond subscription worth 25 billion pesetas and that reimbursement of the bonds was tied to the implementation of an industrial plan.
Steel workers at state-controlled CSI protested on Thursday against plans for a sell-off.
